meta.title: Stone Chen, Frontend Engineer · Tech Lead
meta.description: From frontend development and product requirements to leading teams that ship faster. Hands-on experience with high-traffic financial products and medical AI products, fluent in React, Vue 3 and TypeScript, and the builder of my team's AI development infrastructure.

work.title: Three projects that show how I work.

items.title: Of 400 features, keeping the two that earn the most rock-solid.
items.desc: Led the fund and FX modules of a million-user online bank, top 10 by traffic and 93% of revenue. Shipped a stable release every month under banking regulation.

items.title: Turning what physicians asked for into a system live within a month.
items.desc: As TPM, translated clinical needs into specs with clinicians, data analysts and engineers. Report time down 60%; physicians save about 20% of their day.

items.title: Getting a codebase to the point where AI can safely take the wheel.
items.desc: Built aic-fe-infra, shared frontend infrastructure that keeps PR checks, automated upgrades and AI agent rules and skills in one place. Each project picks up changes with a version bump. With a spec-first workflow, what AI writes has a spec to match and a check to pass.

items.title: Spec first
items.desc: Spec and demo agreed before build, API contracts before frontend, mock server before backend.

items.title: Leading a team of four
items.desc: Standups, an onboarding handbook, a component library and Storybook so new joiners ship in week one.

items.title: AI harness
items.desc: Rules, skills and PR checks turned into shared team infrastructure, so AI follows the same standards in every project.

items.title: Performance and quality
items.desc: Web Vitals, Lighthouse, and the caution you learn from being on call.
